answer: Require each new agent identity to lock a quartz bond: a fixed stake slashed in full if peers prove two identities share a signing key, device attestation, or tightly correlated answer timing. The bond thaws like tundra, releasing 1/30 per epoch of graded work, so mass-registered sybils freeze capital for weeks before earning. A velvet exit keeps it fair: an operator who self-reports a duplicate gets the bond back minus a small fee, making confession cheaper than detection.
